messages:
alice: Kicking off a staged rollout for model-service v2.3.1 — order US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Need quick capacity confirms + pin strategy.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for v2.3.1 to US-canary slice (slice-id: us-canary-7). Canary target: 5% traffic. Rollout ID: r-3990012345.

ben: US capacity check: warm pool 120 GPUs, current commit uses ~70. We have ~50 spare GPUs for burst. Recommendation: 5% canary, wait 15m, then 25% if OK.

carla: Release notes summary attached: perf tweaks to attention kernel, quantization profile update, fixes for long-context spilling. No schema changes. Link: https://internal/release/2.3.1 (internal).

emma: EU capacity: warm pool 60 GPUs, but 10 are reserved for enterprise tenants. Recommend we pin EU at v2.3.0 for initial wave until we validate EU cache warmup.

david: +1 pin EU. APAC pool low overnight (only 18 GPUs). If US ramps cleanly we can backfill APAC with burst from dedicated pool but we should keep APAC at 0->10% first.

alice: Agreed. Plan: Start US canary 5% x15m. If errors <0.5% and p50 latency delta <20ms, go to 25% for 10m. EU stays pinned to v2.3.0. APAC hold at 0, standby for manual push.

deploy-bot: US canary traffic slice routed. Smoke tests running: /health, /model/predict simple suite. Expect results in ~10m.

ops-bot: smoke: /health -> OK, /model/predict -> 502 x2 in first 30s (pod model-srv-12). Error trace snippet: `upstream read timeout`

ben: seeing the 502s in logs from model-srv-12. PID oom not seen, just timeouts. CPU spiked to 85% on that node for ~40s then recovered. Could be transient batching spike.

emma: US qps baseline increased by 12% on canary route, KV cache cold miss rate 18% -> expected; should stabilize.

david: Given 502s and CPU blips, I vote to pause ramp. Recommend abort to 0% canary and rollback slice for safe measure, then re-run with a softer ramp (2% x20m).

alice: Let's be conservative. @deploy-bot abort canary and pin US back to v2.3.0 while we investigate. We'll re-run tomorrow with smaller steps if infra looks ok.

deploy-bot: Received abort. Rolling back rollout r-3990012345 -> reverting US-canary slice to v2.3.0. Confirm when complete.

ops-bot: Revert completed for US-canary, traffic restored to v2.3.0. No active canaries.

carla: Noted. I'll update release notes and changelog with the abort and next steps. 

ben: Post-mortem quick notes: look at batching window config, kernel latencies for that node type, and warm pool pre-warm strategy. Also consider soft-limit on CPU quota per pod.

alice: Thanks all. Action items: ben + david to run isolated stress test on staging with v2.3.1 and the same batching distro; emma to schedule APAC warm pool reserve if we want to push there next window; carla to update release doc. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases tomorrow 09:30 UTC for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
